## Checklist

- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for logic changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or real user data in the diff
- [ ] No unrelated formatting churn
- [ ] No dependency upgrade without a stated reason
- [ ] No database / RLS / auth / storage changes (those are reviewed separately)
